'''Sean Estes''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Seattle tournament]] on 6 May 2000 with Probe Droid ISB, according to Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d677">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-seattle-washington-5-6-00d677/ seattle-washington-5-6-00], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 6 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-seattle-washington-5-6-00d677/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
